Question: Legal ball percentage by each bowler
SQL: SELECT    bowler,    COUNT(*) AS total_balls_delivered,SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*),2) AS legal_ball_percentage FROM cricket_commentary.deliveries GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY total_balls_delivered DESC;

Question: Legal ball percentage by each bowler in innings {innings_number}
SQL: SELECT    bowler,    COUNT(*) AS total_balls_delivered,SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*),2) AS legal_ball_percentage FROM cricket_commentary.deliveries where innings={innings_number} GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY total_balls_delivered DESC;

Question: Legal ball percentage by each bowler and the number of wickets by each bowler
SQL: SELECT bowler,COUNT(*) AS total_balls_delivered,SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*),2) AS legal_ball_percentage,SUM(CASE WHEN wicket = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM deliveries GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY total_balls_delivered DESC;

Question: Legal ball percentage by each bowler and the number of wickets by each bowler in innings {innings_number}
SQL: SELECT Innings,team,bowler,COUNT(*) AS total_balls_delivered,SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*),2) AS legal_ball_percentage,SUM(CASE WHEN wicket = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM cricket_commentary.deliveries where innings ={innings_number} GROUP BY innings,team,bowler ORDER BY total_balls_delivered DESC;

Question: Give me details about each partnership runs for a team
SQL: SELECT team,batter AS striker,non_striker,SUM(runs_batter + runs_extras) AS partnership_runs FROM cricket_commentary.deliveries GROUP BY team,batter, non_striker;

SQL: SELECT team, LEAST(batter, non_striker) AS player1,GREATEST(batter, non_striker) AS player2,SUM(runs_batter + runs_extras) AS partnership_runs FROM cricket_commentary.deliveries GROUP BY team, LEAST(batter, non_striker), GREATEST(batter, non_striker) ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
